description: This file defines the SmsHandler class responsible for handling SMS send and search operations within the application. It interacts with the SmsManager to perform these actions and returns results encapsulated in GatewaySession.InvokeResult objects.

classes.name: SmsHandler
classes.description: A class that manages SMS sending and searching operations, coordinating with SmsManager and formatting results.

methods.name: handleSmsSend
methods.description: Sends an SMS using provided parameters and returns the result as a GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: handleSmsSearch
methods.description: Searches for SMS messages based on given parameters and returns the search results.

methods.name: errorResult
methods.description: Constructs an error result with appropriate error code and message based on input error information.
